question: On October 4, 2024, the MACE telescope was officially inaugurated. Where did this event take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanle**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **MACE (Major Atmospheric Cherenkov Experiment) telescope** was officially inaugurated on **October 4, 2024**. 
• The inauguration took place at the **Hanle** village in the **Union Territory of Ladakh**, India. 
• **Hanle** is already known for hosting the Indian Astronomical Observatory, making it an ideal site for advanced telescopic instruments due to its high altitude and clear skies. 
• The **MACE telescope** is the second-largest gamma-ray telescope in the world and the largest of its kind in the Northern Hemisphere. 
• The telescope is operated by the **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)** in collaboration with the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)</st
